items.stem: On a district map with grid unit 1 km, the villages Devgaon, Nandgaon and Sonpur are at A(2, 3), B(14, 38) and C(14, 3). (i) Find the distance AC. (ii) Find the distance BC. (iii) Find the straight-line distance AB. (iv) How much shorter is the direct road AB than going A → C → B?
items.answer: (i) 12 km (ii) 35 km (iii) 37 km (iv) 10 km
items.markingKey: 1 mark each part.

items.stem: Find the coordinates of the point which divides the line segment joining A(−8, 7) and B(−24, 11) internally in the ratio 1 : 3.
Name the type of quadrilateral formed by the points A(1, 4), B(5, 5), C(3, 13) and D(−1, 12), giving reasons.
items.answer: Rectangle (not a square)
items.markingKey: AB = √17, BC = 2√17, CD = √17, DA = 2√17; AC = √85, BD = √85. Opposite sides equal and diagonals equal: rectangle.

items.stem: A(−1, −5), B(5, −5) and C(9, 0) are three vertices of parallelogram ABCD. Using the fact that the diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other, find D.
items.markingKey: Mid-point of AC = (4, −5/2) = mid-point of BD ⇒ D = (A + C − B) = (3, 0).

items.stem: Explain how to use the distance formula to check whether three points are collinear.
items.answer: Find the three distances; the points are collinear if the sum of two equals the third.
items.markingKey: Key points: Find the three distances; the points are collinear if the sum of two equals the third. Award 2 marks for a complete, correctly reasoned answer.

items.stem: The point P(2, −3) divides the line segment joining A(3, −7) and B(x, y) internally in the ratio 1 : 4. Find B.
The point (k, 11) divides the line segment joining A(−3, 8) and B(−15, 12) in the ratio 3 : 1. Find k.
items.markingKey: Use the section formula for the x-coordinate: k = (3 × (−15) + 1 × (−3))/4 = −12.

items.stem: Show that the points A(2, −4), B(6, −4) and C(2, −1) are the vertices of a right-angled triangle. Which angle is the right angle?
items.answer: Right angle at A (AB² + AC² = BC²: 16 + 9 = 25)
items.markingKey: AB = 4, AC = 3, BC = √(16 + 9) = 5; AB² + AC² = BC², so by the converse of the Baudhayana-Pythagoras theorem ∠A = 90°.

items.answer: ((m₁x₂ + m₂x₁)/(m₁ + m₂), (m₁y₂ + m₂y₁)/(m₁ + m₂))

items.answer: Not collinear

items.stem: In a classroom drill, four students stand at A(4, 3), B(9, 3), C(9, 8) and D(4, 8) on a grid with unit 1 m. (i) Find AB and BC. (ii) Find the diagonals AC and BD. (iii) What figure do the students form? Justify. (iv) Find the distance of the centre of the figure from A.
items.answer: (i) 5 m, 5 m (ii) 5√2 m each (iii) square: equal sides and equal diagonals (iv) 5√2/2 m
